name: kaiba
description: Ontology-oriented notes on Cloudflare Workers with user-key AI tooling

scripts.build: bun run --cwd web build && bun run build:api
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/domain/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/application/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/adapter/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/ai/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json && bun run --cwd web typecheck
scripts.lint: bun run lint:biome && bun run typecheck
